description:
Re-score all constellation entries in a campaign and rewrite queue positions from highest to lowest composite score. Use after new engagers or targets are added. Free — costs 0 credits.

Note: this tool requires a `campaign_id` because it writes back to the `constellation_entries` table. Segment- and url-list-scoped scoring is not yet supported — use `get_outreach_queue({segment_id})` or `get_outreach_queue({linkedin_urls})` for engagement-count ordering on those scopes; full composite scoring will land alongside the unified person-positions schema in a later phase.
name: score_connections
title: Score Connections
